content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"趙司晨"},{"ref":"m2","surface":"鄒七嫂"},{"ref":"m3","surface":"假洋鬼子"},{"ref":"m4","surface":"秀才"},{"ref":"m5","surface":"吳媽"}],"relations":[{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m5","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"趙司晨的妹子眞醜。鄒七嫂的女兒過幾年再說。"}]},{"subject_ref":"m3","object_ref":"m5","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"假洋鬼子的老婆會和沒有辮子的男人睡覺，嚇，不是好東西！"}]},{"subject_ref":"m4","object_ref":"m5","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"秀才的老婆是眼胞上有疤的。"}]}],"alias_proposals":[]}
